messages:
Taylor Nguyen: Kicking off slow-burn rollout (slice 3) to US -> EU -> APAC. Target window 02:00-06:00 UTC. Ops, SRE, please watch APAC capacity closely — warm pool is low.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: service=inference-runtime, version=2026-03-20-canary, slice=slice-3, targets=[us,eu,apac]

Jin Park: Quick note — APAC GPU pool shows low spare vram on p-gpu-04. Can we reduce default batch from 16 -> 8 for APAC to keep latency SLO?

Priya Sharma: +1 to batch tweak. Also suggest pinning APAC to model-4q8a (quant) as fallback if mix-8 starts to OOM.

Taylor Nguyen: Agreed. Priya, can you push a policy change to route APAC to model-4q8a on OOM and enable canary fallback to model-4q8a immediately if errors > 1% for 5m?

Priya Sharma: Doing it now.

ops-bot: Policy update applied: route-on-error(apac) -> model-4q8a, threshold=1%, window=300s

Marco Ruiz: SRE: warming an extra 8 instances in APAC warm-pool now. ETA ~4m.

oncall-sre: Observability note — added alert: apac.inference.high_oom_rate severity=warning at 0.5%, page at 2%

Jin Park: Decreasing batch-size and quantized pin applied in apac config:
```
region: apac
batch_size: 8
fallback_model: model-4q8a
```

deploy-bot: Canary rollout to US succeeded. EU canary partial success (latency +10ms). APAC canary failing health-checks (OOM) -> rolling back APAC canary.

Taylor Nguyen: Good. Rollback APAC to previous stable (2026-02-19-stable). Keep US/EU progressing but hold for 30m while APAC stabilizes.

Priya Sharma: Rollback executed for APAC -> version=2026-02-19-stable. Warm pool +8 applied. Monitoring.

ops-bot: Rollback success: apac -> 2026-02-19-stable. Warm pool size=+8.

oncall-sre: Observed brief spike in latency in EU after APAC rollback (cross-region). Backpressure normalized in 6m.

Marco Ruiz: Suggest we run a small capacity smoke test: send 50 rps to APAC with batch_size=8 and quant variant to confirm stability before re-trying slow-burn.

Taylor Nguyen: Agreed. Jin, can you run the smoke test now and paste results?

Jin Park: Running.

Jin Park: Smoke test results: 60s steady @50rps -> 99th p90 latency=210ms, OOM events=0, token throughput stable. CPU spike on control-plane ~15%. Looks green.

Taylor Nguyen: OK. Plan: hold US/EU rollout at 30% traffic for next 20m, do APAC canary with batch 8 + quant model, enable monitoring and rollback trigger at error>0.75%.

Priya Sharma: I'll set the rollback trigger and pin policy. Also adding a manual note to release notes: 'APAC: using quant fallback and reduced batch to mitigate OOMs during warmup.'

deploy-bot: Re-deploying APAC canary: version=2026-03-20-canary, batch_size=8, fallback=model-4q8a

ops-bot: Canary APAC health -> initial checks passed. Will monitor for 15m.

oncall-sre: Keeping pages unmuted. If error rate >0.75% for 3m we roll back to 2026-02-19-stable.

Taylor Nguyen: Thx everyone. After 15m, regroup for full slow-burn continue or abort. Add any notes to the release thread.

Priya Sharma: noted. I'll update release notes and the rollout ticket with the steps.

deploy-bot: Canary APAC -> success at 2026-03-20T02:17:40Z. Traffic slice advanced to 20% APAC, US/EU at 30%.

Marco Ruiz: Warm pool now at target. Monitoring steady.

oncall-sre: No alerts in the last 10m.

Taylor Nguyen: Proceed to continue slow-burn per schedule. If anything, call rollback immediately. :thumbsup:

Priya Sharma: added to release notes: 'APAC slow-burn: reduced batch, quant fallback, warm pool increase, rollback threshold 0.75%.'

end-of-thread-bot: Thread closed by Taylor Nguyen.
